major_cooldowns.name: Dragonrage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every two minutes and press Fire Breath and Eternity Surge inside it so Animosity extends the window, then spend the four Unbound Flame casts it turns into.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: It is off the global cooldown, so fire it inside Dragonrage to make Eternity Surge instant at max rank and only put it on Fire Breath when Eternity Surge is not ready.

major_cooldowns.name: Eternity Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at rank 1 and bank it going into Dragonrage, where Tip the Scales turns it into a free max rank cast.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 359073 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses; the same-name 359077 is not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Always cast it at rank 1, keep both charges moving, and refresh it once the dot is at 30% duration or less.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 357208 is the inhale cast seen in 5/5 parses; 357209 is the enemy dot aura, and 1283718 and 1283719 are unobserved twins.

major_cooldowns.name: Deep Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Scalecommander press it on cooldown at minimum range, cancel the flight with the cancelaura macro the moment you make contact, and in single target hold the Strafing Run repeat until that buff is nearly gone.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The guide writes Deep Breath as 357210, but the id logs record as a cast in 5/5 parses is 433874, the Maneuverability version. Cooldown is the table base_cd_s of 120; Onyx Legacy takes a minute off it and Wingleader shortens it further, which is why top parses cast it far more often than the base allows.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of the Aspects
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the raid's lust call, since it hands everyone Bloodlust and locks them out of similar effects for ten minutes.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Marked talent_gated so a raid where another player provides the Bloodlust effect is not scored as a missed cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Empowering Venom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Outside of AoE, hold this damage trinket until you have 4 stacks of Rising Fury inside Dragonrage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket, cast in 2/5 parses; marked talent_gated so players carrying different trinkets are not scored as missing casts.

defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a big hit for 30% less damage taken, and Renewing Blaze heals back what it prevents over the next 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for raid-wide area damage to cut 20% off what you and the four nearest allies take.

defensives.name: Verdant Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Heal yourself or a hurt ally with it, and use it before the pull to bank a Scarlet Adaptation shield.
defensives.id_note: 360995 is the row carrying the cooldown and marked castable; the same-name 361195 shows 0 casts across the sampled parses. Class talent node, so talent_gated is set.

rules.description: Open Dragonrage into Eternity Surge and Fire Breath
rules.action: Press Dragonrage first, then send Eternity Surge and rank 1 Fire Breath inside it before you spend Mass Disintegrate.

rules.description: Keep the Fire Breath dot on your target
rules.action: Refresh rank 1 Fire Breath once the dot is at 30% duration or less.

rules.description: Tip the Scales spent on Eternity Surge
rules.action: Follow Tip the Scales with Eternity Surge and only fall back to Fire Breath when Eternity Surge is not ready.
Bank Eternity Surge as Dragonrage comes up so it extends the window with Animosity.

rules.description: Living Flame over Azure Strike with Burnout up
rules.action: Burnout makes Living Flame instant, so send it even on the move and save Azure Strike for when you cannot cast.

rules.description: Spend Essence before filling with Living Flame
rules.action: Dump full Essence into Disintegrate first and press Living Flame while it refills.
